content.short: Firebird Finance provides several DeFi products such as Swap, OneSwap, Vault, and Farms-as-a-Service.
content.description: Firebird Finance is a multi-chain DeFi platform delivering a cohesive suite of high-performance tools across Ethereum, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Multichain, and Solana. It offers Swap, OneSwap, Vault, and Farms-as-a-Service, providing efficient, secure, and yield-oriented DeFi experiences designed to drive innovation and dependable returns for users. The project aims to meet diverse DeFi needs and rewards participation with cash-back in its native utility token.
